Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 5. Generic Installation, Commissioning, Testing, Configuration, Training (if any - which ever is applicable as per scope of supply) is to be carried out by OEM / OEM Certified resource or OEM authorised Reseller. 6. Generic Malicious Code Certificate:

The seller should upload following certificate in the bid:- (a) This is to certify that the Hardware and the Software being offered, as part of the contract, does not contain Embedded Malicious code that would activate procedures to :- (i) Inhibit the desires and designed function of the equipment. (ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. Bidder Eligibility & Relevant Experience 1. Bidder shall have successfully completed minimum 2 similar specialized technical training assignments during the last 3 financial years in the relevant domain. 2. Generic IT/computer training shall not be considered equivalent to specialized domain training. 3. Bidder shall submit relevant Work Order/PO and Completion/Performance Certificate as documentary proof. 4. Bidder shall have an average annual turnover of minimum ₹25 lakh during the last 3 completed financial years. 5. Training shall be delivered by qualified Subject Matter Experts having minimum 5 years relevant domai n experience. Trainer CV shall be submitted. 6. Minimum 40% of the training duration shall involve practical laboratory exercises, demonstrations, assignments, case studies and hands-on assessment. 7. Bidder shall possess or have authorized access to the required specialized hardware, software, laboratory infrastructure and tools relevant to the course. 8. For Mobile Network Security/SDR training, bidder shall demonstrate capability in 2G/3G/4G/5G security, SDR-based testing, cellular testbeds, protocol/signaling analysis and authorized SIM/USIM laboratory environments. 9. For Drone Forensics training, bidder shall demonstrate capability in DJI flight-log acquisition/analysis, telemetry analysis, drone evidence handling, forensic reconstruction and technical reporting. 10. Buyer may conduct a technical demonstration/evaluation prior to award to verify the bidder's pra ctical

capability and availability of required infrastructure. 11. Bidder shall provide training material, practical assignments, assessment and individual course completion certificates. 12. All practical activities involving RF, cellular networks, drones or digital evidence shall be conducted only in authorized, controlled and legally compliant environments.
